name: Eric
preview: Sarah: Got it, thanks Eric, that's useful to know. Your 40T is set, and the team will confirm the $100 credit with you. Enjoy the rest of your day.

messages.text: Happy to help with that. What's your order number, and either the name on the order or the postcode?

Thanks Eric, got it. Order Shop····, one Harlo B30 plus the free Power Kit, paid, nothing shipped yet. It ships October 15.

Before I take it further, what changed for you? If it's the wait, that date is close now, and you're a few days from having it. If it's something else, tell me and I'll sort it from here.
I want the MagicMiner 40T instead. Is it possible to just swap the order to that instead?

Yes, I can do that swap myself. One thing to weigh first: your B30 ships October 15, while the 40T available now is Batch 7, a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026. So it's a longer wait.

Money side: the 40T is $799 against the $899 B30, so $100 comes back as store credit on your account for your next order. Your Power Kit stays on the order.

Want me to go ahead?
Handed to the team · swap_done plus $100 store credit still to be issued and warehouse re-read pendin

Done, Eric. Shop···· now carries the Magic (address hidden), Batch 7, a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026, with your Power Kit in the same box. Nothing more to pay, your balance is $0.00, and you'll get the updated-order email.

The $100 difference goes back as store credit on your account, which applies at checkout on your next order. I've passed that to the team and they'll confirm it with you shortly. Anything else while you're here?
Before you go, one thing: you came in to cancel the B30, then chose the 40T even with the longer wait. What made you want off the B30?

The B30 is less efficient in my eyes. Plus, I’m getting more hashrate for the same price with the MagicMiner. The B30 seemed like a great buy until the HQ01 came along. Waiting a month and a half is an easy trade off to make.
Where did you first come across the HQ01?
Got it, thanks Eric, that's useful to know. Your 40T is set, and the team will confirm the $100 credit with you. Enjoy the rest of your day.
